refuted_under: StrictTopC AND HasAtMostTwoInteractionProfiles at every coordinate
derivation: Obtained by rounding the D-NF coefficient vector of B3strict_m6_c0_margin0.01.json in the 70-dimensional closed-form fibre basis to denominator 65, then clearing denominators. Rounding IN THE FIBRE BASIS cannot break rank one -- every basis column provably lies in V_lambda -- so only the numeric verdict could change, and it did not. The decision ratio is positively homogeneous of degree 1 in F, so clearing denominators is exact.

independent_recomputation.method: recomputed from the definitions with no repo evaluator: Q_i(u) as the product-reference expectation over contexts, delta_square as the maximum mixed-difference oscillation, losses as half the oscillation of the marginal residual, rank one as ALL 2x2 centred-profile minors
independent_recomputation.note: A first attempt at this recomputation was WRONG: it ranged contexts over all 729 actions while the update overwrites coordinate i, counting every context three times and inflating every C_i by exactly 3. That error is recorded because it is the kind that silently produces a fake disagreement.

why_it_supersedes: Same refutation, but every world value is an integer in [-65, 25] with 18 distinct values, against denominators up to 1.38e19 in the original. That is the difference between a Lean witness that can be checked by kernel arithmetic and one that cannot.
limits: One exact witness at m=6, K=3, corner reference. It refutes a universally quantified claim, which needs exactly one counterexample. It says nothing about what the correct constant is.
